# Connect to Fathom's MCP server

Query and analyse your Fathom data in your chosen AI tool or platform

Updated over 2 weeks ago

🎉 Beta feature: Fathom's MCP is currently in beta, so you must turn on the beta flag to access it. If you run into any issues or have feedback, please reach out to our team at support@fathomhq.com.

# What is an MCP server?

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides your AI tool with access to your Fathom data and the context the tool needs to understand the data.

By connecting Fathom’s MCP server, your AI tool has the logic behind how the data relates to one another, not just the hard-coded numbers. MCP servers help AI tools, like large-language models (LLMs), understand your data when you ask a natural language question, so the tool can retrieve and reference the correct data.

## What can you do with Fathom's MCP server?

With Fathom’s MCP server, you can use natural language to interrogate and analyse your Fathom data in your chosen AI tool (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, etc.).

📝 Note: We've heard from users that the "free version" of Claude does not allow you to use PAT tokens to connect to MCPs, including Fathom's MCP server.

​You can bring your Fathom data into your connected AI tool, but you cannot send instructions or data back into Fathom.

Fathom's MCP server will provide the connected AI tool with the following types of data:

  * The Fathom organisations or accounts you are a member of
​
  * The companies connected to your Fathom organisation(s) that you can access
​
  * P&L data for your entities
​
  * Balance Sheet data for your entities
​
  * KPI data for your entities
​
  * Cash flow statement data for your entities
​
  * Chart of accounts data for your entities

Forecast and budget data currently cannot be accessed via Fathom's MCP server.

# How to connect to Fathom's MCP server

You can connect your AI tool to Fathom’s MCP server with a Personal Access Token (PAT). The PAT will provide your AI tool with read-only access to your data in Fathom.

Because PATs are specific to the individual, your PAT will be able to read data according to your personal role and permissions in Fathom. You cannot access additional data in Fathom with your PAT.

📝 Note: OpenAI's ChatGPT and Google's Gemini do not support PAT connection, so it is currently not possible to connect them to Fathom's MCP server.

Instructions for AI tools vary, so we recommend asking your tool for the most up-to-date instructions.

You can enter the following prompt in your AI tool to get it to generate instructions for you:
I use a tool called Fathom to track and analyse financial data. I want to give [AI tool’s name] access to my data in Fathom via Fathom’s MCP server. Fathom provides me with a Personal Access Token (PAT) to access the Fathom MCP server. The URL to connect to Fathom’s MCP server is https://api.fathom.dev/mcp. Please give me step-by-step instructions for connecting Fathom’s MCP server to [AI tool’s name].

Once you have the instructions from your AI tool, you're ready to create a PAT token for Fathom (make sure you have the appropriate permissions).

To get a PAT for Fathom:

  1. Click the User icon in the top right of the ‘My Companies’ page.
​
​
  2. Select Personal Access Tokens from the dropdown menu.
​
📝 Note: If you do not see the ‘Personal Access Tokens’ option, you may not have permissions to create them in Fathom. An Admin-level user in your Fathom organisation will have to provide you with the ‘Setup > Create Access Tokens’ advanced user permission.
​
  3. Click Create a token.
    1. Name the token. Make the name specific for easier identification later if you need to manage or revoke access.
    2. Select an expiry date for the token (30, 60, or 90 days). The token will automatically expire and cannot be renewed. Instead, you will generate a new token when needed.
​
​
  4. Copy the token immediately. The token is only shown when it’s created, so if you navigate away from the page or refresh the page without copying it, you will have to create a new token.
​
​Be careful and treat your PAT like a password, as anyone who has access to it can access your Fathom data.
  5. As part of the MCP server connection process, your AI tool may ask you for the following when you create the MCP server connection:
    1. A URL to connect to Fathom. You can enter the following URL when needed: https://api.fathom.dev/mcp.
    2. A name for the Fathom MCP server connection. Name it something simple and easy to identify, like 'Fathom'.
    3. Your PAT token.


# Managing or revoking access

## Manage or revoke your own MCP server connections

You can view and remove your own PATs from the Personal Access Tokens page. Removing a PAT will remove the MCP server connection/access provided to the associated AI tool.

To manage or remove your PATs:

  1. Click the User icon on the top right of the ‘My Companies’ page.
​
​
  2. Select Personal Access Tokens from the dropdown menu.
​
​
  3. You will see your PATs. If you are part of multiple Fathom organisations, you will be able to see which Fathom organisation is associated with a PAT.
​
​
  4. To revoke a PAT, click Revoke access.

### Which AI tools work with Fathom MCP?

Fathom MCP works with ChatGPT (through the Fathom app), Claude (through the Fathom connector or Claude Code), and any MCP-compatible tool using the server URL https://api.fathom.ai/mcp.

### How do I connect Fathom to Claude or ChatGPT?

Add the Fathom app in ChatGPT or the Fathom connector in Claude, or point any MCP-compatible tool at Fathom’s MCP server and sign in with your Fathom account.

### Which meetings can my AI assistant see?

Your AI assistant can access only the meetings you have permission to view in Fathom. MCP doesn’t open up any new data.

### Is Fathom MCP free?

Yes. Fathom MCP is available on every Fathom plan, including Free. Your AI assistant’s own plan requirements may apply.

### How is Fathom MCP different from Ask Fathom?

Ask Fathom answers questions inside Fathom. Fathom MCP brings the same meeting context into the AI assistant where you’re already working, alongside your docs and other connected tools.

### Can I use Fathom MCP in Claude Code?

Yes. Add the Fathom MCP server in Claude Code to reference customer calls and meeting decisions while you build.

### What can I do with Fathom MCP?

Draft QBR narratives, mutual action plans, battlecards, launch messaging, and product requirements from real meeting context, or ask your assistant what a customer pushed back on last week.
